src/main.js.name: Start-up
src/main.js.description: Starts the app in the right language with the saved setup and game, and wires up Start over (two taps) and the light and dark switch.

src/ui.js.name: Screens and game turns
src/ui.js.description: Draws the welcome, play and end-of-game screens, plays the coach's turn after a short wait, shows Help me's ring, saves the game on the phone and drops the confetti.
